pack.title: Dry replies & left on read
pack.description: K. Sure. Seen 9:41pm. Match the energy or end the thread with grace.

scenarios.setting: Text thread. You sent three warm paragraphs; the reply arrives in minutes.

replies.line: Talk when you have words. I'm here.
replies.why: It names the dynamic without chasing, and leaves the door standing open.
It matches the energy exactly and spends nothing more on the thread.

replies.line: Haha — busy day? Catch me up later.
replies.why: Assuming the best gives them a graceful reason and you a graceful exit.

replies.line: A whole letter. Don't spend it all at once.
replies.why: Treating the k as generosity roasts the dryness without roasting the person.
It reviews the thread like a ride, which says everything without sending more.

trap.line: Wow ok. Guess I'll just stop texting you then.
trap.why: Announcing your exit over one dry reply makes a mood into a breakup.

scenarios.setting: Dating app. After a good exchange, they vanish for six days, then:
scenarios.jab: hey sorry lol crazy week. wyd

replies.line: Busy week here too. Coffee Thursday or we let it fade.
replies.why: It names the fork honestly — a plan or a goodbye — with no bitterness.
No grudge, one concrete plan — their answer tells you everything.

replies.line: Haha no worries — weeks happen. Still want that coffee?
replies.why: Forgiving the fade while re-offering the plan keeps it light and real.

replies.line: Six days of crazy. Hope Thursday is calmer — coffee?
replies.why: It clocks the gap with a smile while still offering the date.

replies.line: Crazy week? Mine filed for calm.
replies.why: Matching their excuse with paperwork keeps the re-offer light.

scenarios.setting: Friend thread. You've been left on read for two days after asking a favor.

replies.line: Bumping this once. A no is fine too.
replies.why: One bump plus permission to decline gets you an answer either way.

replies.line: Need an answer. Yes or no.
replies.why: It shrinks the ask to a binary, which is the easiest text to send.

replies.line: No pressure either way — just need to know by Friday.
replies.why: Removing pressure while adding a deadline makes replying safe and urgent.
It roasts the feature instead of the friend, which gets the faster reply.
It states the chat's terms of service in five flat words.

trap.line: Hello?? I can see you read it.
trap.why: Prosecuting the read receipt turns a slow friend into a defensive one.
